content_html:
TL;DR

Meta launched Seller, a dedicated iOS app for Marketplace power sellers with AI listing creation, unified inbox, and performance insights

Meta has launched Seller, a standalone app built for people who sell regularly on Facebook Marketplace, giving them dedicated tools for managing listings, communicating with buyers, and tracking sales performance in a single place. The free app is available now on the App Store for US users aged 18 and older, and syncs automatically with existing Marketplace listings, messages, and selling history. The launch coincides with Marketplace’s tenth anniversary, a platform that now sees 430 million items listed globally each month.

The centrepiece is AI-powered listing creation. Sellers upload photos and Meta AI fills in the title, description, suggested price, and category, reducing what was once a multi-step process to a quick review and publish. A bulk listing feature lets sellers post multiple items at once, and a unified inbox organises all buyer conversations by item so that no message thread gets lost between the main Facebook app and the new one.

Seller also includes a performance dashboard that surfaces views, clicks, message threads, and completed sales, giving frequent sellers the kind of data that e-commerce platforms like eBay and Etsy have offered for years but Marketplace largely lacked. The app is currently iOS-only, with a web experience for those who download it and Android testing underway. Selling through social platforms has become a serious income source for a growing number of people, and Meta is betting that a dedicated app can keep its most active sellers from drifting to rivals like TikTok Shop and Whatnot.

The Seller app is part of a broader set of Facebook updates announced on the same day. Meta is introducing Facebook Verified, a free badge that confirms a real person stands behind a profile through selfie verification, which will appear on Marketplace, Dating, Groups, and profile pages starting Monday. The company is also testing a full-screen, TikTok-style video feed that would greet users the moment they open the Facebook app, starting in video-heavy international markets later this year with a possible US rollout in 2027.

For Meta, the bet is that Marketplace’s sheer scale, more than a billion active users and a decade of embedded buying habits, can hold its own against purpose-built commerce platforms if the seller experience catches up. The broader shift toward AI-driven commerce is reshaping how people buy and sell online, and Meta is positioning Marketplace as a platform where the AI does the tedious work of listing and the seller focuses on sourcing and shipping. Whether a standalone app is enough to retain power sellers who increasingly have options elsewhere is the question the next year will answer.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Meta 推出了 Seller，这是一款专门为 Marketplace 超级卖家打造的 iOS 应用程序，具有 AI 列表创建、统一收件箱和绩效洞察功能

Meta 推出了 Seller，这是一款为经常在 Facebook Marketplace 上销售的用户打造的独立应用程序，为他们提供了专门的工具来管理列表、与买家沟通以及在一个地方跟踪销售业绩。 这款免费应用程序现已在 App Store 上供 18 岁及以上的美国用户使用，并自动与现有的 Marketplace 列表、消息和销售历史记录同步。 此次发布恰逢 Marketplace 成立十周年，该平台目前每月在全球范围内列出 4.3 亿件商品。

核心是人工智能驱动的列表创建。 卖家上传照片，Meta AI 填写标题、描述、建议价格和类别，将曾经的多步骤流程简化为快速审核和发布。 批量列表功能允许卖家一次发布多个商品，统一的收件箱按商品组织所有买家对话，这样 Facebook 主应用程序和新应用程序之间就不会丢失任何消息线程。

Seller 还包括一个绩效仪表板，可显示视图、点击、消息线程和已完成的销售，为频繁的卖家提供 eBay 和 Etsy 等电子商务平台多年来提供的数据，但 Marketplace 基本上缺乏。 该应用程序目前仅适用于 iOS，下载者可以享受网络体验，Android 测试正在进行中。 通过社交平台进行销售已成为越来越多的人的重要收入来源，Meta 认为一款专门的应用程序可以防止其最活跃的卖家转向 TikTok Shop 和 Whatnot 等竞争对手。

卖家应用程序是 Facebook 同日宣布的一系列更广泛更新的一部分。 Meta 推出了 Facebook Verified，这是一款免费徽章，可通过自拍照验证来确认个人资料背后是否有真人，该徽章将从周一开始出现在 Marketplace、Dating、Groups 和个人资料页面上。 该公司还在测试一款类似 TikTok 的全屏视频源，该视频源会在用户打开 Facebook 应用程序时向用户打招呼，将于今年晚些时候在视频密集的国际市场开始测试，并可能于 2027 年在美国推出。

对于 Meta 来说，赌注是，如果卖家体验迎头赶上，Marketplace 的庞大规模、超过 10 亿的活跃用户和十年来的嵌入式购买习惯将能够在与专门构建的商务平台的竞争中站稳脚跟。 向人工智能驱动的商务的更广泛转变正在重塑人们在线购买和销售的方式，Meta 将 Marketplace 定位为一个平台，人工智能可以在其中完成繁琐的上市工作，而卖家则专注于采购和运输。 一个独立的应用程序是否足以留住那些在其他地方越来越有选择的大卖家，这是明年将回答的问题。
